• Crypto total market cap fell 13.6% over 30D: Total crypto market cap at $2.56T (13.6% lower over 30D). Related: Securitize pushes into $6 trillion asset-backed finance market with River One acquisition (CoinDesk).
  • Losses broadened among top-50 alts: 3 names up more than ~0.5%, 34 down more than ~0.5%, and 4 roughly flat out of 41 non-stable coins with a valid 1M % (top-50 table). Related: Bitmine reports $6.3 billion net loss in latest fiscal year, driven by 44% ether decline (The Block).
  • Regulatory framing still decides product access: Enforcement and legislation shocks tend to pull risk into majors first, while higher-beta categories retrace until policy clarity returns. Related: Solana set for its first tokenized stock venue under SEC framework, listing Galaxy (CoinDesk).
  • Listed ETF flows remain the cleanest demand gauge: Listed-product demand usually hits Bitcoin first, then filters into broader market beta if primary-market creations stay firm. Related: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $1.66B over seven trading sessions (CoinTelegraph).
